usedFor: Field service teams use Zoho FSM, where “Create Service Report” records an appointment and “Create Asset” links equipment.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Service Report” in Zoho FSM
bestTemplate.why: It writes a service report for an appointment, so the job is on record.

watchOut: “Update Company” in Zoho FSM changes a company's name or service address, so check which company an earlier step passes.
